extensions.platform: Native egui 0.36 + egui-snarl 0.12 desktop app. Tokens are Rust constants in crates/aic-editor/src/style.rs; CSS here is a preview translation only (1pt = 1px at 1x).

mono.purpose: Numbers in panels and port rates.

number.purpose: The number a card is about.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default egui button: flat control fill, 1pt divider outline; hover lightens and strengthens the outline; pressed takes an accent outline. No size change.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #D3D5DA; background: #26282D; border: 1px solid #26272B; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; min-height: 20px; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2E3036; border-color: #44474F; color: #F3F4F6; } .ds-btn:active { background: #36383F; border-color: #6E9BFF; color: #F3F4F6; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #9CBBFF; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Selected Toggle
components.description: A selectable button or row in its on state: the selection wash with selection ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-selected { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #9CBBFF; background: #243761; border: 1px solid #26272B; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; } .ds-btn-selected:hover { border-color: #44474F; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset well; focus draws the selection-ink outline; unparseable input turns red.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" placeholder="Search by name"> <input class="ds-field ds-field-bad" value="1o">
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #D3D5DA; background: #0F1012; border: 1px solid #26272B; border-radius: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 0 4px; caret-color: #6E9BFF; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #868991; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #44474F; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #9CBBFF; } .ds-field-bad { color: #EF6461; }

narrative.overview:
The category standard played straight: a dark node editor with quiet neutral chrome, so the graph and
its numbers are the only loud thing on screen. The craft bar is the Figma and Linear desktop apps
(neutral chrome, 1px dividers, restrained accent, polished popovers) with Satisfactory Modeler's
function. Dark because the app sits on a second monitor beside the running game.

Density is high and deliberate: 13pt text, 20pt controls, 3pt row gaps, built for 27" screens at
1440p and 4K with keyboard and mouse. Polish means precision (pixel-snapped hairlines, aligned
numbers, contrast that holds at 1x), not decoration. No glow, gradients or themed costume.
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite ramp: canvas, then panels, then cards and popovers, each one step lighter.
One blue, for selection and focus only. Every other hue is a state.
Inter for words, JetBrains Mono for numbers that must line up; both embedded, identical on macOS and Windows.
1pt hairlines, 4/6/8 radii, short soft shadows only on things that float.
Act, don't ask: no confirm dialogs, no OK/Cancel; undo and autosave are the safety net.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent marks selection and focus, nothing else. Hyperlinks are `TEXT_MUTED`; status is never blue.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Pink is pulled from the depot, green is sent to it (or a storage filling), amber is a warning, red is an error. A hue used for decoration breaks the reading of every number on screen.

rules.name: The Tested Contrast Rule
rules.body: Contrast is enforced by unit tests in `crates/aic-editor/src/style.rs`: every text and state color is ≥4.5:1 on canvas, panel, raised and inset; `TEXT_STRONG` is ≥7:1 and `TEXT_MUTED` ≥4.5:1 on every header tint; `ACCENT_TEXT` ≥4.5:1 on `ACCENT_FILL`. A new color or tint joins those tests.

rules.name: The Real Bold Rule
rules.body: egui's `.strong()` only changes color. Emphasis is `theme::strong(text)` (semibold family + `TEXT_STRONG`); a heading-sized emphasis adds `.size(text::HEADING)`.

rules.name: The Aligned Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that sits in a column or updates in place is mono. Words are never mono.

rules.name: The 1x-First Rule
rules.body: Design at 1x (1440p, Windows 100%), then check 1.5x and 2x. Custom painting snaps to pixels; hairlines are 1pt. `subpixel_binning` is off so text renders the same everywhere.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Panels, bars and controls carry no shadow; a 1pt divider separates them.

dos: **Do** take every color, size and radius from `theme`; a literal `Color32` or font size in a widget is a bug.
**Do** put every user-facing string through Fluent (`crates/aic-editor/i18n/en.ftl`), with terse labels.
**Do** make one gesture do the thing: right-click opens the picker with search focused, one click places the node, edits apply at once.
**Do** give every command a keyboard shortcut and light its toolbar button when the key is pressed.
**Do** rely on undo and background autosave as the safety net; the app reopens the last document.

**Do** verify through egui_kittest snapshots (1280x800 at 1x). After a token change, delete `crates/aic-app/tests/snapshots/*.png`, then run `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test -p aic-app`: kittest only rewrites images past its diff threshold.
donts: **Don't** add confirm dialogs, OK/Cancel pairs or "discard changes?" prompts.
**Don't** let a panel, dialog or tool cover the work or wait to be dismissed.
**Don't** use blue for anything but selection and focus, or a state hue for decoration.
**Don't** add hover expansion, glow, gradients or shadows on chrome.
**Don't** over-explain: no help copy where a label, icon or number does the job.
